prompt: Fix the snippet snippets/unit-price-label.liquid so that it renders a unit price label with correct pluralization. Inputs (all top-level variables, none under section.settings): - price: string or null. An already formatted price such as "$4.99". - count: integer or null. The number of units the price refers to. - unit: string, never null. The singular unit name, such as "ounce". Rules: 1. Output nothing (empty string) if any of these is true: price is null, price is the empty string "", count is null, or count is less than 1 (0 or negative). 2. If count is exactly 1, output exactly: PRICE per UNIT 3. If count is greater than 1, output exactly: PRICE per COUNT UNITs. The plural is formed by appending a lowercase "s" to the unit, with no other changes. Example: price "$4.99", count 3, unit "ounce" gives $4.99 per 3 ounces. 4. PRICE and UNIT must be HTML-escaped. For example, < becomes <, > becomes >, & becomes & and " becomes ". COUNT is printed as a plain integer. 5. Do not output any whitespace or newlines before or after the span. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/unit-price-label.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
